ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity bias with high-intensity pixels limited to approximately 2-5% of total surface area, primarily at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey/black pigmentation across the contiguous fluke surface. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with approximately 35-degree interior angle and clear vertical depth separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along both lobes; prominent irregular macro-indentation (tissue loss) on the inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature of the trailing edge with an upward-tapering sweep toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive high-contrast white clusters of roughly circular geometry localized at the left and right fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, suggesting previous tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Protruding, textured white clusters on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke, consistent with heavy barnacle colonization.
